cues.text: Quick one before the leash comes out. Three checks, every walk.
One. Does the collar fit? Two fingers should slide under.
Two. Is the ID tag readable, with your current number?
Three. Pack water, especially on warm days.
Unsure about your pet's needs? Ask your vet.
PETTO keeps walks and reminders in one place.
PETTO. Free on iOS and Android.
